name: recurrence-detector
description: Close the growth loop's DETECT step: read the exhaust every run already sheds — stop-reports, scope-fence findings, unmet criteria, diary entries — cluster it by failure shape, and surface any shape seen at least N times as a named candidate invariant with its sightings cited. Proposes; never scaffolds. Use when asking what keeps going wrong, or before adding a skill on a hunch.
